acceptanceCriteria: PLAN P4C.3 bullet (verbatim, slice): skipped/detached occurrences. Explicit 'this occurrence' versus 'whole series' edit/delete. Stable series and occurrence IDs; no duplicate detached events on retries.

Still no UI wiring and no persistence (US-063 owns storage); all behavior proven at the pure-function level
